title: SurfClust
description: A program to perform clustering analysis surfaces

input_surf_name.description: Full name of the input surface
input_surf_name.title: Input surface file

input_dataset.description: The input dataset and the index of the datacolumn to use (index 0 for 1st column). Values of 0 indicate inactive nodes.
input_dataset.title: Input dataset

rmm.description: Maximum distance between an activated node and the cluster to which it belongs.
rmm.title: RMM radius

prefix.description: Prefix for output. Default is the prefix of the input dataset.
prefix.title: Output prefix

out_clusterdset.description: Output a clustered version of input dataset
out_clusterdset.title: Output clustered dataset

out_roidset.description: Output an ROI dataset with the rank of its cluster
out_roidset.title: Output ROI dataset

out_fulllist.description: Output a value for all nodes of input surface
out_fulllist.title: Output full list

sort_n_nodes.description: Sorting based on number of nodes in cluster
sort_n_nodes.title: Sort by number of nodes

sort_area.description: Sorting based on area of clusters (default)
sort_area.title: Sort by area

thresh_col.description: Index of thresholding column. Default is column 0.
thresh_col.title: Threshold column index

athresh.description: Apply absolute thresholding prior to clustering
athresh.title: Absolute threshold value

ir_range.description: Apply thresholding in range. A node n is considered if thresh_col[n] >= R0 && thresh_col[n] <= R1
ir_range.title: In range threshold

ex_range.description: Apply thresholding outside of range. A node n is considered if thresh_col[n] < R0 || thresh_col[n] > R1
ex_range.title: Out of range threshold

prepend_node_index.description: Force the output dataset to have node indices in column 0 of output.
prepend_node_index.title: Prepend node index

update.description: Pacify me when perc of the data have been processed. perc is between 1% and 50%. Default is no update.
update.title: Update percentage

no_cent.description: Do not find the central nodes
no_cent.title: Do not find central nodes

novolreg.description: Ignore any Rotate, Volreg, Tagalign, or WarpDrive transformations present in the Surface Volume.
novolreg.title: Ignore volume registrations

set_env.description: Set environment variable ENVname to be ENVvalue. Quotes are necessary.
set_env.title: Set environment variable

trace.description: Turns on In/Out debug and Memory tracing.
trace.title: Trace

mini_help.description: Mini help, same as -help in many cases.
mini_help.title: Mini help

extreme_help.description: Extreme help, same as -help in majority of cases.
extreme_help.title: Extreme help

view_help.description: Open help in text editor. AFNI will try to find a GUI editor on your machine. You can control which it should use by setting environment variable AFNI_GUI_EDITOR.
view_help.title: Open help in editor

web_help.description: Open help in web browser. AFNI will try to find a browser. You can control which it should use by setting environment variable AFNI_GUI_EDITOR.
web_help.title: Open help in web browser

find_help.description: Look for lines in this program's -help output that match (approximately) the given word.
find_help.title: Find help keyword

spx_help.description: Help string in sphinx format, but do not try to autoformat.
spx_help.title: Sphinx help

aspx_help.description: Help string in sphinx format with autoformatting of options.
aspx_help.title: Autoformat sphinx help
